fieldissues.issue: The title calls prospective postal governors 'political agents,' a stronger characterization than the body supports; the long also repeats the medium verbatim before adding context.
The lower-case opening 'this episode begins' and references to what the account 'does not prove' read like review notes rather than a finished account.
Authoritarianism / Government Power Abuse may overstate the documented postal-board appointments and recommendations.
The tags repeat generic category labels and omit USPS, the task-force report, and board appointments.

proposedchanges.change: Use a neutral title such as 'Steven Mnuchin Took an Active Role in USPS Governance and Board Selection'; remove 'political agents'.
Remove the duplicated opening and recast the closing review language as a direct account of the reported appointments and attributed criticism.
Use a neutral government-administration classification if available; otherwise clear Government Power Abuse until the record supports that label.
Use U.S. Postal Service, postal task-force report, board of governors, postmaster general, and Treasury Department.

evidencebasis: The packet and merged descriptions support the report, Mnuchin's role in governor selection, and attributed criticism of Treasury involvement. The merged row retains the source URL.
notes: The existing medium is clear and adequately qualified; the long adds useful context but needs a distinct, reader-facing opening.
